journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

articles.title_en: Adaptation Infrastructure and Its Effects on Property Values in the Face of Climate Risk
articles.title_cn: 适应基础设施及其在气候风险下对房产价值的影响
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the effect of climate adaptation infrastructure investments on property transaction prices, using data on over 400,000 property transactions and 162 infrastructure projects in Miami-Dade County, an area that is highly vulnerable to flooding and sea level rise due to climate change. Exploiting the timing and siting of different adaptation projects in Miami-Dade, we are able to identify significant gains in property values after completion of adaptation infrastructure projects. These gains are concentrated in areas close to the project and for projects that are visually identifiable. Our results suggest an aggregate mean benefit, net of adaptation cost, of about $0.68 million per project and almost $300 million in aggregate net benefits for all projects in our sample. Most projects generated positive net benefits, indicating that the vast majority of adaptation efforts are being placed in areas passing a benefit-cost test.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了气候适应基础设施投资对房产交易价格的影响，使用了迈阿密-戴德县超过400,000笔房产交易和162个基础设施项目的数据，该地区由于气候变化而极易受到洪水和海平面上升的影响。利用迈阿密-戴德县不同适应项目的时间和选址差异，我们能够识别出适应基础设施项目完成后房产价值的显著增长。这些增长集中在项目附近区域以及视觉上可识别的项目。我们的结果表明，扣除适应成本后，每个项目的总体平均收益约为0.68百万美元，而我们样本中所有项目的总体净收益接近300百万美元。大多数项目产生了正的净收益，表明绝大多数适应努力正被投入到通过成本效益检验的区域。

articles.title_en: The Price of Indoor Air Pollution: Evidence from Risk Maps and the Housing Market
articles.title_cn: 室内空气污染的代价：来自风险地图与住房市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study uses the housing market to examine the costs of indoor air pollution. We focus on radon, a common indoor air pollutant which is the leading cause of lung cancer after smoking. For identification, we exploit a natural experiment whereby a risk map update in England induces exogenous variation in published pollution risk levels. We find a significant negative relationship between changes in published pollution risk levels and residential property prices. Interestingly, we do not find a symmetric effect for decreasing risk. We also show that the update of the risk map led higher socioeconomic groups (SEGs) to move away from affected areas, attracting lower SEG residents via lower prices. Overall, our results demonstrate that indoor air quality has material economic effects on the housing market and provide novel policy-relevant insights into how the market responds to information on environmental risks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用住房市场考察室内空气污染的成本。我们关注氡，这是一种常见的室内空气污染物，是继吸烟之后导致肺癌的首要原因。为了进行识别，我们利用了一项自然实验，即英格兰的一次风险地图更新引发了已公布污染风险水平的外生变化。我们发现，已公布污染风险水平的变化与住宅物业价格之间存在显著的负相关关系。有趣的是，我们并未发现风险下降具有对称效应。我们还表明，风险地图的更新导致较高社会经济群体（SEGs）迁离受影响地区，并通过较低价格吸引较低SEG居民迁入。总体而言，我们的结果表明，室内空气质量对住房市场具有实质性的经济影响，并就市场如何回应环境风险信息提供了新的政策相关见解。

articles.title_en: Water in Scarcity, Women in Peril
articles.title_cn: 稀缺中的水，危险中的女性
articles.abstract_en: We provide evidence that groundwater scarcity results in an increase in sexual violence against women. Negative shocks, measured as the year-to-year variation in subsurface water from the long-term mean, result in an increase in reported rapes. We bolster our identification by providing insights from geology that explain why annual fluctuations in subsurface water are largely geogenic and hence exogenous. We posit that these negative shocks increase the time required for women to collect water from outside the house, thus exposing them to a heightened risk of violent attack. We find empirical support for this hypothesis and show evidence that makes alternative explanations untenable.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供证据表明，地下水稀缺导致针对女性的性暴力增加。负面冲击，以地下水的逐年变化相对于长期均值来衡量，导致报告的强奸案增加。我们通过提供地质学见解来加强我们的识别，这些见解解释了为什么地下水的年度波动在很大程度上是地质成因的，从而是外生的。我们假设这些负面冲击增加了女性从户外取水所需的时间，从而使她们面临更高的暴力攻击风险。我们找到了对这一假设的实证支持，并展示了使替代解释站不住脚的证据。

articles.title_en: Impact of Climate Change on Crop Pests and Diseases: Ensemble Modeling of Time-Varying Weather Effects
articles.title_cn: 气候变化对作物病虫害的影响：时变天气效应的集合建模
articles.abstract_en: The impacts of climate change on crop yields have been extensively studied worldwide, yet the mechanisms underlying changes in yields are not fully understood. This study investigates the relative importance of pest effects using observational data. As weather effects could vary depending on the timing of exposure, I model time-varying weather effects by separating the entire cropping season into thousands of possible growth-stage combinations and select the top-performing models using the cross-validation method. The empirical application reveals that the proposed method achieves a much better prediction performance than conventional methods. By simulating climate change impacts in central and southern Japan, I find that crop yields decrease by approximately 10% and 30% for rice and wheat, respectively. However, pest effects only explain one-tenth of the overall effect of climate change, which suggests that climate change will harm crop growth directly, rather than through disease and pest epidemics.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化对作物产量的影响已在世界范围内得到广泛研究，然而产量变化背后的机制尚未被完全理解。本研究利用观测数据考察害虫效应的相对重要性。由于天气效应可能因暴露时间的不同而变化，我通过将整个作物生长季划分为数千种可能的生长阶段组合来建模时变天气效应，并使用交叉验证方法选择表现最好的模型。实证应用表明，所提出的方法比传统方法取得了好得多的预测性能。通过模拟日本中部和南部的气候变化影响，我发现水稻和小麦的作物产量分别下降约10%和30%。然而，害虫效应仅解释了气候变化总体效应的十分之一，这表明气候变化将直接损害作物生长，而非通过病虫害流行。

articles.title_en: Paper Water, Wet Water, and the Recognition of Indigenous Property Rights
articles.title_cn: 纸面水、实际水与原住民财产权的承认
articles.abstract_en: Restoring natural resource access for Indigenous groups has become a recent policy focus. We combine satellite data and robust difference-in-difference methods to estimate the causal effect of Native American water right settlements on land and water use on reservations in the western United States over 1974–2012. We find that settlements increase cultivated agricultural land use (crops and hay/pasture) by 8.7%. Our estimates of tribal water use indicate that, even after accounting for water leased off-reservation, many tribes are utilizing only a fraction of their entitlements, forgoing as much as $938 million–$1.8 billion in revenue. We provide evidence suggesting that this gap is driven, in part, by land tenure constraints and a lack of irrigation infrastructure.
articles.abstract_cn: 恢复原住民群体对自然资源的获取已成为近期的政策重点。我们结合卫星数据和稳健的双重差分方法，估计美国西部保留地上美洲原住民水权和解对土地和水使用的因果效应，时间跨度为1974-2012。我们发现，和解使耕地农业用地使用（作物和干草/牧场）增加了8.7%。我们对部落用水量的估计表明，即使考虑到保留地外租赁的水，许多部落也仅使用了其应得水权的一小部分，放弃了高达938百万美元至1.8十亿美元的收入。我们提供的证据表明，这一差距部分是由土地权属限制和缺乏灌溉基础设施造成的。

articles.title_en: Monitoring Technologies, Environmental Performance, and Health Outcomes: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 监测技术、环境绩效与健康结果：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we take the establishment of automatic surface water quality monitoring stations (automatic stations) in China as an example to explore the effects of adopting advanced monitoring technologies in enforcing environmental regulations. Automatic stations use real-time water quality monitoring and electronic-reporting technologies to go beyond traditional field inspection and monitoring and create novel enforcement approaches. We show that the establishment of downstream automatic stations significantly restrains industrial water pollution discharged and benefits human health. Specifically, the establishment of downstream automatic stations reduces wastewater emissions from upstream counties by 22%. Consequently, the death rate from digestive diseases decreases by 2.26 persons per 10,000 population and the life expectancy at birth increases by 3.14 years with the establishment of downstream automatic stations. This study provides clear evidence that advanced monitoring technology improves enforcement of environmental regulations, which brings significant health benefits and enhances social welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们以中国建立自动地表水水质监测站（自动站）为例，探讨采用先进监测技术在环境法规执行中的效果。自动站利用实时水质监测和电子报告技术，超越了传统的实地检查和监测，创造了新的执法方式。我们表明，下游自动站的建立显著抑制了工业水污染排放并有益于人类健康。具体而言，下游自动站的建立使上游县的废水排放减少了22%。因此，随着下游自动站的建立，消化系统疾病死亡率每10,000人口减少了2.26人，出生时预期寿命增加了3.14年。本研究提供了明确的证据，表明先进的监测技术改善了环境法规的执行，从而带来了显著的健康效益并提升了社会福利。

articles.title_en: The Hidden Cost of Bananas: The Effects of Pesticides on Newborns’ Health
articles.title_cn: 香蕉的隐性成本：农药对新生儿健康的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of aerial fumigation of banana plantations on newborns’ health during the period 2015–17 in Ecuador. Using the mothers’ addresses, the perimeter of the plantations, and the amount of pesticides applied in each plantation, we determine newborns’ exposure to pesticides. We then implement a difference-in-differences strategy that exploits seasonal variations in the use of pesticides to identify the causal effect of fumigations on newborns’ health outcomes. Our analysis shows that newborns with a high exposure to pesticides during gestation have a birth weight deficit of between 80 and 150 grams. Moreover, exposure to pesticides increases the likelihood of low birth weight and preterm delivery. We validate our results with a maternal fixed effect model that compares the health outcomes of siblings exposed and not exposed to intensive fumigations. We also carry out placebo and falsification tests considering newborns exposed to other crops not using aerial fumigations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了在厄瓜多尔2015-17期间，香蕉种植园空中熏蒸对新生儿健康的影响。利用母亲的住址、种植园的边界以及每个种植园施用的农药量，我们确定了新生儿对农药的暴露程度。然后，我们实施了一种双重差分策略，利用农药使用的季节性变化来识别熏蒸对新生儿健康结果的因果效应。我们的分析表明，在妊娠期间高度暴露于农药的新生儿，其出生体重不足在80至150克之间。此外，暴露于农药增加了低出生体重和早产的可能性。我们用一个母亲固定效应模型验证了我们的结果，该模型比较了暴露于和未暴露于密集熏蒸的兄弟姐妹的健康结果。我们还进行了安慰剂和证伪检验，考虑了暴露于其他不使用空中熏蒸的作物的新生儿。

articles.title_en: Endogenous Risk and Habitat Loss from Climate Change: An Application to Seal Management after the November Rain
articles.title_cn: 气候变化导致的内生风险与栖息地丧失：应用于十一月雨后的海豹管理
articles.abstract_en: The role of climate change on stochastic resource growth has yet to be analyzed in a bioeconomic setting, which is important given that increased weather variability is a key climate change feature. We construct a bioeconomic analysis in which mean and variance impacts of climate change produce multiple elements—population stochasticity, mean habitat loss, and greater habitat variability—impacting the riskiness of resource management. Our results show that change in the variance of weather events is an important consideration for managing at-risk species and may create countervailing conservation incentives relative to considering only mean impacts. We apply our analysis to North Atlantic harp seals, which are uniquely susceptible to climate change, as they require sea ice to breed and raise their pups. Harp seal conservation incentives and negative economic impacts of habitat loss are tempered when accounting for both reduced mean sea ice levels and increased sea ice variability.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化对随机资源增长的作用尚未在生物经济背景下进行分析，而鉴于天气变异性增加是气候变化的一个关键特征，这一点很重要。我们构建了一个生物经济分析，其中气候变化的均值与方差影响产生多个要素——种群随机性、平均栖息地丧失以及更大的栖息地变异性——影响资源管理的风险性。我们的结果表明，天气事件方差的变化是管理濒危物种的一个重要考虑因素，并且相对于仅考虑均值影响，可能产生相互抵消的保护激励。我们将我们的分析应用于北大西洋格陵兰海豹，它们特别容易受到气候变化的影响，因为它们需要海冰来繁殖和养育幼崽。当同时考虑平均海冰水平下降和海冰变异性增加时，格陵兰海豹的保护激励和栖息地丧失的负面经济影响会被削弱。
